entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
I swear an oath by the Day of Resurrection.
And I swear an oath by the excessively self-blaming soul (of a pious believer).
Does man assume that We will never gather his bones?
Why not? We are (even) able to make all his finger joints (again), in a perfect order.
Rather, man desires to commit evil (by denying the Day of Judgement, which is) in front of his sight.
He (i.e. man) asks, 'When will the Day of Resurrection be?'
Then, the Day when the eyes are dazzled.
And the moon will be eclipsed.
And the sun and the moon will be put together.
On that Day, mankind will say, 'Where is the (place of) escape?'
Never! There is no refuge.
On that Day, the place of rest is towards your Lord only.
On that Day, man will be informed of all what he sent ahead and left behind.
Rather, man himself is a complete witness upon his own condition.
And even if he presents all the excuses he has, he will still not be heard.
You (O Beloved), do not move your tongue along with the Qur'aan in order to memorise it quicker.
Indeed, protecting it (in your chest) and (your) reciting (it) is Our responsibility.
So, when We have recited it (through Jibra'eel), you should thereupon follow what is being recited.
Then indeed, to explain its minute details is Our responsibility.
Not at all; rather, O disbelievers! You love this world (and its benefits).
And you have discarded the Hereafter.
On that Day, some faces will be bright.
Looking towards their Lord.
And on that Day some faces will be horrified.
(They) will be thinking that some calamity is going to be inflicted upon them, which may break the back.
Yes, certainly! When the soul will reach up to the throat.
And people will say, 'Is there any soothsayer (to restore him)?'
And he will realise that this is the time of parting.
And one shin will intertwine with the other shin (i.e. the feet will be wrapped up in the shroud).
On that Day, (everyone) will be driven only towards your Lord.
(A disbeliever will be punished because) neither did he accept (Islam as) the truth, and nor did he offer Salah.
Yes; he belied and turned his face away.
Then he went back to his house arrogantly.
Woe to you (at the time of death), and woe again (in the grave).
Again, woe to you (on the Day of Resurrection), and woe again (in Hell).
Does man assume that he will be let loose?
Was he not just a drop of that sperm that is discharged?
Then it became a clot of blood, so He created, then made him proper.
So, He made from it (i.e. the sperm-drop) two pairs; male and female.
Will He, Who has done all this, not be able to give life to the dead?
